description:
Due to an unexpected accident, Hong Cha-yoon fell from a genius dancer to the caregiver of Whimoon Group's Chairman, Tae Woo-seop, . While staying at a country villa to care for Chairman Wang, she unintentionally becomes entangled with Whimoon Group's head of department, Tae Moo-kyung... Is Cha-yoon just a fleeting fling for this arrogant, yet overwhelming man, who grabs hold of anyone she pushes away, or is she the beginning of love?

[Original Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=11346053)
